text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Admire Vega
observing the plaza.
Following her gaze, I saw—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hwahaha! O glorious Sun!
Shine forth with ever greater brilliance for my sake!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Nay, if I wish to express the Sun's divine blessing,
perhaps this pose suits better! Right, once more!

It seemed she was closely observing TM Opera O.
Afterward, I caught glimpses of her engaging in various
trial-and-error efforts around the academy—

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's way too much meat!
What gives? Is it like a cheat day or something?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Nah. Just building muscle.
You need pretty solid core strength during photo shoots.
Well, gonna go grab seconds.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Seconds, of that...?
...Kuh.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... Sitting in seiza for two hours...
makes my legs... go numb after all............ Gh.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Smooth, yet fluffy.
I have no choice but to get that one.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If I keep looking at that plushie,
surely... the corners of my mouth will...

...Every time I happened upon her,
she was doing something remarkably arduous.

And today as well, she stood in the plaza
with a deeply brooding expression.
Unable to ignore it any longer—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ! ...It's nothing, I'm fine.

Ehh? Are you sure? Even though you were glaring
at your phone late into the night with a super grumpy face~?

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
I bet it's that, right!
Preparing for the inn modeling gig coming up?

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
If that's it, staying up late is a big no-no, okay~?
It's bad for your skin, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I know that.

Their exchange reminded me of the poster modeling request
I had sat in on the other day.
It seems everything she was doing was for that sake.
However... considering her reaction back then—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?
choice_data_list: You weren't keen on it, so I'm surprised.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...The fact remains that I accepted it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If I'm going to do it, I'll do everything within my power.
It's as simple as that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Are you done?
I'll be going now.

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
She brushed you off, huh♪
Still... Ayabe-san really plays unfair~

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
Awkward, yet so earnest.
That part of her is truly—

There may be a mysterious power in the way Admire Vega lives
that naturally draws people in...
